reason: The gap addresses a potential risk factor for Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID) that is understudied, namely short-term hospital admissions. By comparing the proportion of SUID cases with hospital overnight stays to the weighted prevalence among PRAMS mothers, this research could provide insights into whether infants who have had hospital stays are at higher risk for SUID. This information would be valuable for understanding potential risk factors and informing preventive measures.
